mechanism: Methylprednisolone increases nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk of amikacin through immunosuppression and renal tubular dysfunction, while amikacin may reduce corticosteroid efficacy in infectious processes.
action: Monitor renal function (BUN, creatinine, eGFR) and audiometry regularly; maintain adequate hydration; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of amikacin; ensure lowest effective corticosteroid dose and duration.
